title: IPFS-style content distribution improvements
description: From an IPFS-usage analysis (2026-10-17). Agora uses CIDs everywhere but deliberately keeps private ciphertext off the public IPFS network (DHT lookups link fetchers to CIDs). Guiding rule: use IPFS networking freely for public content and direct device-to-device exchange; keep private ciphertext off the public DHT; always verify by CID regardless of source.
